description: Serves the plan v7 section 8.3 expression clause for missing/null/cross-axis operands, raw-string non-equality (both '==' and '!='), and runtime operand typing. Deliberately generic keys and variable names ('value', 'left', 'right') so one compiled expression can be driven with many runtime operand types -- integer, decimal, plural operands, raw CharSequence, JSON boolean, and each language-form axis -- entirely from the case file. Static operand typing is NOT exercised here because lokalized-java rejects it at load/construction time (verified; see the skipped list); canBeEqualExpressionValue treats every VARIABLE as UNKNOWN_VARIABLE, which is compatible with everything, and that deferral is precisely what makes these runtime cases authorable while their bare-constant twins are not. Only 'en' is loaded, so tiebreakers is null.

Expr.Operand.LeftNotEqualsRight.commentary: The non-equality operator, so a port cannot pass the raw-string rule by special-casing '==' alone.

Expr.Operand.ValueVsPhoneticConstant.commentary: Bounds the 'a caller string is PHONETIC' rule: an explicit Phonetic value compares without a resolver, a raw string does not.
